research_result.description: Binance is a global cryptocurrency exchange providing extensive APIs, WebSocket streams, and MCP servers for market data, spot and derivatives trading, wallet management, and automated trading.
research_result.credential_requirements: Developers must register a Binance account, complete identity verification (KYC), enable 2FA, and make a deposit into their Spot Wallet to generate API keys. OAuth 2.0 application access is gated and restricted to close ecosystem partners.
research_result.main_blocker: Creating API keys requires identity verification (KYC) and account funding, while OAuth 2.0 authorization is restricted to approved ecosystem partners.

evidence.claim: Binance APIs support OAuth 2.0 authentication, but access is currently restricted to close ecosystem partners.
evidence.quote_or_excerpt: For now, Binance Login (Oauth2.0), is exclusively offered to close ecosystem partners. Please reach to our business team for further information.

evidence.claim: API key creation requires completing identity verification (KYC), enabling 2FA, and depositing funds into the account.
evidence.quote_or_excerpt: Please note that before creating an API Key, you need to make a deposit of any amount to your Spot Wallet to activate your account and complete identity verification.

evidence.claim: Binance offers broad REST and WebSocket APIs covering spot trading, futures, margin trading, and wallet management.
evidence.quote_or_excerpt: Official Documentation for the Binance Spot APIs and Streams

evidence.claim: Binance launched an official Model Context Protocol (MCP) server alongside Binance Agent OS.
evidence.quote_or_excerpt: Binance launched Binance Agent OS and its Model Context Protocol Server on Aug. 20, giving compatible artificial intelligence applications controlled access to market data and trading functions.

evidence.claim: Binance Open Platform supports JWT signature authentication for open API requests.
